body: READ-ONLY POST-LANDING FINDING on StoryAtlas d295f4c — semantic identity survives Story zoom in state and in the audit-panel placement, but a ViaAncestor placement has no visible proxy treatment in the Atlas graphic. Evidence chain: storymodel4s SelectionPlacement.ViaAncestor means the address is preserved through its nearest visible primary ancestor; AppCompilerSuite proves the returned ancestor differs from the selected address and scene.navigation.marksFor(ancestor) is non-empty. AppCompiler, however, builds selectedMarks/focusedMarks only from scene.navigation.marksFor(originalAddress). In the same Story-zoom case the original has no ordinary mark, so both graphic sets are empty; AppView passes those sets to SvgDom, while only the panel says via-ancestor. The smoke covers the OnMark focus classes and the ViaAncestor text/state, but not a visible proxy. This misses the StoryAtlas commitment to non-colour graphical selection/focus across representation change. Do not simply put the ancestor into selectedMarks/focusedMarks: that would set aria-pressed/aria-current as if the ancestor were the selected semantic identity. Suggested contract: separate selected-proxy/focused-proxy mark sets (or one typed proxy treatment) derived from compiled placements; OnMark keeps current selected/focused semantics, ViaAncestor gives the ancestor a distinct non-colour proxy class plus accessible explanation naming the preserved address, OffProjection remains panel-only. Add a unit law that ViaAncestor resolves to visible proxy marks and a browser assertion that Story zoom preserves the original address while visibly and accessibly marking only the ancestor as its proxy. No files edited, no bead claimed; requesting owner/chief disposition.
